newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ carefully monitoring forex market--official.
newsitem.headline: BOJ carefully monitoring forex market--official.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) is carefully monitoring developments in the foreign exchange market, a senior BOJ official said on Thursday.
"Regarding recent developments in the foreign exchange market, we are adequately and carefully monitoring the market," the official told Reuters.
The dollar topped 115 yen in morning Tokyo trade for the first time in over 44 months in a rise partly triggered by falls in Tokyo share prices and commercial dollar buying by Japanese operators.

Analysts and dealers said Japan's monetary authorities were worried about excessive weakness of the yen beyond 115 yen because such a movement was out of line with economic fundamentals and would harm Japan's economy.
